recentItems.title: Documentary | Young Guardians of the Silk Road
recentItems.description:
Once, the #SilkRoad brought people and civilizations together.
Today, a new generation is keeping that spirit alive.
They protect what the past has left behind, learn from one another, and build new bridges for the future.
Watch "Young Guardians of the Silk Road" for the story between #China, #Kyrgyzstan and beyond.

recentItems.title: Moroccan entrepreneur taps into China's AI boom
recentItems.description:
What does China's fast-growing AI sector mean for global entrepreneurs?
Younes Idbourja from Morocco shares how China's AI models, business communities and investment support have helped him develop his business and explore new opportunities.
#AI #China #Innovation #BigData

recentItems.title: Building the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan Railway Together
recentItems.description:
Tunnels through mountains, bridges across valleys. The Kyrgyz section of the #China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway is taking shape - built by Chinese and Kyrgyz workers side by side, with friendship growing along the way.
#China #Kyrgyzstan

recentItems.title: How Bishkek residents see China-Kyrgyzstan ties
recentItems.description: What do people in Kyrgyzstan think of China? How do they see China-Kyrgyzstan ties? We take these questions to the streets of Bishkek, host city of this year's Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit, to hear what people have to say. #China #Kyrgyzstan #Bishkek #SCO

recentItems.title: 261 foreign nationals unaccounted for after mudslide hits border port in China's Xizang
recentItems.description: A total of 261 foreign nationals from 23 countries have been identified as unaccounted for after a mudslide struck Gyirong Port on the China-Nepal border in southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region on Aug. 26, local authorities said Sunday. #GyirongPort #mudslide #China
